avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may increase linagliptin metabolism and reduce efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antidepressant if needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose closely; adjust dosing if hypoglycemia occurs

caution_supplements.name: Chromium
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; counsel on signs of hypoglycemia

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay but not significantly reduce linagliptin absorption
caution_foods.action: Can take with or without food; consistency recommended

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase linagliptin levels slightly
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for adverse effects if intake unavoidable

monitoring_notes: Linagliptin undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism and is primarily renally cleared unchanged, resulting in few significant drug-nutrient interactions. Monitor for hypoglycemia when combined with other glucose-lowering supplements or in renal impairment.
